selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection after Git-index postimage binding exposed a narrower ownership defect: gitLocalCommit stages only run-owned paths, but plain `git commit` commits every path already present in the Git index. Preexisting user-staged or unrelated staged changes could therefore be silently included in an autonomous delivery commit; a preexisting staged version of a run-owned path could also be overwritten by the agent's `git add`.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: Fresh main reduced the next reproducible bottleneck to one evidence-rich central delivery-integrity defect, so the committed four-mode router's singular-bottleneck gate routes the replay to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT. No forced mode rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC/UPDIA success receipt or fabricated numeric score is claimed.

sequence: Create base commit containing a.txt and b.txt.
Modify b.txt and stage it before autonomous delivery.
Modify run-owned a.txt, then mirror current delivery sequence: git add -A -- a.txt followed by plain git commit.
Observed HEAD contains both a.txt and b.txt; the unrelated pre-staged b.txt entered the autonomous commit.

changes: gitLocalCommit now checks the existing Git index before any run-owned staging occurs.

Any preexisting staged path fails closed with GIT_INDEX_PREEXISTING_STAGED_CHANGES before git add or commit, preserving both unrelated staged work and a preexisting staged version of a run-owned path.

The ownership failure is surfaced through the existing indexIntegrity-shaped evidence so NorthStarRunner's current delivery failure path moves the run to REPAIR_REQUIRED without adding a second delivery-state architecture.
Clean-index validated delivery and the existing post-staging validation-receipt binding remain unchanged.

validation.tests: 5/5 focused Git delivery regressions PASS on the Linux verification host
coverage: existing staged-byte postimage drift remains rejected
unrelated preexisting staged work is rejected and preserved
preexisting staged version of a run-owned path is rejected and preserved
validation.verification_scope_note: The local harness exercises the exact modified index-ownership/postimage functions and repository test cases. Unchanged remote-delivery helpers were not executed because the verification host intentionally had no GitHub network credentials and no Actions were used.

truth_boundaries: This closes accidental consumption or overwrite of preexisting staged Git index state by local autonomous delivery; it does not make the index immutable after the ownership check.
A later concurrent process or Git hook can still mutate the index between integrity verification and commit creation; that separate race is not claimed closed here.
Fail-closed behavior intentionally prefers user sovereignty over silently adopting existing staged work; it does not attempt to infer ownership of preexisting staged entries.
OS-level validation sandboxing, arbitrary complex semantic synthesis, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, and crash-level filesystem atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions are intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push is used, and no credential, payment, formal Release, or destructive/irreversible external action is performed.
